changes.from:
While healing another Survivor, for each Hook State they have:
• You heal 40% faster.
• Great basic Skill Checks, grant 3% more progress.
• Basic Skill Checks are 5% more likely to appear.
changes.to:
While healing another Survivor, for each Hook State they have:
• You heal 40% faster.
• Great basic Skill Checks grant 3% more progress.
• Basic Skill Checks are 5% more likely to appear.

changes.from:
When the Trial starts:
• 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
• The Basement Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
While you are at least 24m away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, any Generator that isn't being repaired regresses at 200% speed.
changes.to:
When the Trial starts:
• 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
• The Basement Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
While you are at least 24m away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, any Generator that isn't being repaired regresses at 200% speed.
When the Survivor is no longer hooked this effect ends in 30s.

changes.from:
You basic-vault Windows 25% faster.
Your missed basic-attack cooldown is 25% shorter.
Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, the duration is 25% longer.
changes.to:
You basic-vault Windows 15% faster.
Your successful basic-attack cooldown is 15% shorter.
Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned the duration is 15% longer.

changes.from:
Whenever a Generator is completed, when the Killer gets within 20m of you, for 15s:
• You see the Auras of Pallets and Windows within 32m.
• You see the Auras of other Survivors.
• You see the Killer's Aura.
changes.to:
When the trial starts, and after a Generator is completed, you earn 1 Token, up to 5.
When the Killer gets within 20m of you, spend 1 Token. Then, for the next 15s:
• You see the Auras of Pallets and Windows within 32m.
• You see the Auras of other Survivors.
• You see the Killer's Aura.
